摘要Abstract

在本文中，我们研究了重复游戏中的遗憾最小化In this paper, we study regret minimization in repeated games with适应性adaptive可以根据比赛历史做出反应的对手。标准度量为opponents who can respond based on histories of play. The standard metric of外在的遗憾external regret众所周知，在线学习无法捕捉到这种适应性。为了考虑玩家的反事实推理，我们引入in online learning is known to fail to capture such adaptivity. To account for players’ counterfactual reasoning, we introduce重复政策遗憾（RP-Regret）Repeated Policy Regret (RP-Regret)，一种博弈论度量，用于衡量, a game-theoretic metric that measures the difference between the实现了realized和and the事后最好的best-in-hindsight当所有玩家都可以时累积效用accumulated utility when all players can回应respond到游戏的历史。与这种设置中现有的后悔概念相比，我们的后悔概念天生就是重复博弈，使得比较者和对手具有更少的约束，同时保持在所有玩家最小化平衡时找到更好平衡的可能性。我们首先确定获得的必要条件to the history of play. Compared to existing regret notions in this setting, ours is native to repeated game playing, enabling stronger comparators and opponents with fewer constraints, while maintaining the possibility of finding better equilibria when all players minimize it. We first identify necessary conditions for obtainingRP-遗憾RP-Regret时间上的亚线性，关于后悔定义中玩家的比较策略的变化以及比较者和对手策略的记忆。然后我们研究额外的条件和可证明的算法来最小化sublinear in time, on the variation of the player’s comparator strategies in the regret definition and on the memories of both the comparator and opponents’ strategies. We then study additional conditions and provable algorithms to minimizeRP-遗憾RP-Regret，根据定义, which is by definition非凸non-convex在战略空间中。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了三种算法：（i）一种基于优化预言机，正如在线非凸学习的一些先前工作中所假设的那样； (ii) 最小化凸和in the strategy space. To address this challenge, we propose three algorithms: (i) one based on an optimization oracle, as assumed in some prior work in online non-convex learning; (ii) one that minimizes a convex and线性化linearized的替代者surrogate ofRP-遗憾RP-Regret在每次迭代时； (iii) 直接最小化at each iteration; (iii) one that directly minimizesRP-遗憾RP-Regret当对手慢慢改变策略时。此外，当所有玩家都可以运行算法来最小化when opponents change strategies slowly. Furthermore, when all players can run algorithms to minimize theRP-遗憾RP-Regret（或其线性化变体），可以学习重复博弈的某些子博弈完美平衡。我们还提供了实验，表明最大限度地减少我们的遗憾观念可以导致在诸如“猎鹿”之类的游戏中具有更高效用的更多合作解决方案。(or its linearized variant), certain subgame perfect equilibria of the repeated game can be learned. We also provide experiments showing that minimizing our regret notions can lead to more cooperative solutions with higher utility in games such as Stag-Hunt.111已接受在 2026 年学习理论会议 (COLT) 上发表演讲。Accepted for presentation at the Conference on Learning Theory (COLT) 2026.

4.2.1 用有限的内存重新设计重复游戏 作为马尔可夫游戏Reformulating Repeated Games with Bounded Memory as Markov Games

我们将证明每个时间步长的预期损失可以通过无限范围平均损失马尔可夫/随机博弈的预期损失来近似We will show that the expected loss at each timestep can be approximated by the expected loss of an infinite-horizon average-loss Markov/stochastic game(Shapley, 1953; Gillette, 1957; Filar and Vrieze, 2012), 并基于此重构开发后悔最小化算法。, and develop a regret minimization algorithm based on this reformulation.

5 平衡计算通过Equilibrium Computation viaRP-遗憾RP-Regret最小化Minimization

在本节中，我们将研究新的遗憾概念的一个重要含义——In this section, we investigate one important implication of our new regret notion –平衡计算equilibrium computation，在重复的博弈中。我们将重点关注, in repeated games. We will focus on the无限地infinitely重复的游戏设置，而不是repeated game setting, instead of the有限地finitely重复了一个。这是因为，对于一次性矩阵博弈，当其 NE 唯一时，其有限重复版本的唯一子博弈完美纳什均衡是在每个时间步上玩一次性博弈的 NErepeated one. This is because, for a one-shot matrix game, when its NE is unique, the only subgame perfect Nash equilibrium of its finitely repeated version is playing the NE of the one-shot game at every timestep(Benoit and Krishna, 1985)。因此，求解有限重复博弈的NE退化为求解一次性矩阵博弈的NE。 另一方面，单次矩阵博弈中 NE 的唯一性并不罕见——对于两人零和矩阵博弈，具有非唯一 NE 的博弈集合的勒贝格测度为零. Therefore, solving the NE of the finitely repeated game degenerates to solving the NE of the one-shot matrix game. On the other hand, the uniqueness of NE for a one-shot matrix game is not uncommon — for two-player zero-sum matrix games, the set of games with non-unique NEs has Lebesgue measure zero(Van Damme, 1991; Bailey and Piliouras, 2018)。 因此，我们接下来将注意力集中在无限重复的一般和博弈设置上。. Hence, we will hereafter direct our attention to the infinitely repeated general-sum game setting.

5.1 重复博弈中的均衡Equilibria in Repeated Games

6 结论Conclusion

在本文中，我们研究了与自适应对手重复游戏中的遗憾最小化，这些对手可以根据游戏历史做出反应。为此，我们倡导了一个新的衡量标准，In this paper, we studied regret-minimization in repeated games with adaptive opponents who can respond based on the histories of play. To this end, we advocated a new metric,RP-遗憾RP-Regret，这是本设置的本机，并确定了一系列必要的 获得条件, which is native to this setting, and identified a series of necessary conditions for obtainingRP-遗憾RP-Regret时间上呈亚线性。然后我们开发了额外的条件和可证明的算法来最小化sublinear in time. We then developed additional conditions and provable algorithms to minimizeRP-遗憾RP-Regret，然后连接, followed by the connection ofRP-遗憾RP-Regret最小化某些已知的子博弈完美均衡计算。我们的工作为未来的研究开辟了新的方向，包括由以下因素引起的较弱均衡概念的发展minimization to certain known sub-game perfect equilibria computation. Our work opens new directions for future research, including the development of weaker equilibrium notions induced byRP-遗憾RP-Regret§ 中的最小化minimization in §4，可能需要较弱的假设来计算。 它还提高了通过以下方式获得可证明的均衡选择结果的可能性, for which weaker assumptions may be required to compute. It also raises the possibility of obtaining provable equilibrium-selection results viaRP-遗憾RP-Regret具有特定支付结构的游戏中的最小化。minimization in games with particular payoff structures.

重复博弈中的均衡计算。Equilibrium Computation in Repeated Games.

重复正态博弈中的学习和均衡计算是一个经过充分研究的领域。一个众所周知的民间传说结果是，当所有玩家都运行无（外部）后悔学习算法时，平均迭代将收敛到一次性矩阵博弈的粗略相关平衡Learning and equilibrium computation in repeated normal-form games is a well-studied area. One well-known folklore result is that when all the players run no-(external-)regret learning algorithms, the average iterates will converge to the coarse correlated equilibrium of the one-shot matrix game(Cesa-Bianchi and Lugosi, 2006)。 在重复玩游戏的过程中， 由于玩家可以根据过去的观察改变策略，因此重复博弈的均衡可能与单次博弈的均衡不同。对此，利用著名的民间定理. In playing repeated games, since the players could change their strategies based on past observations, the equilibrium for the repeated game can be different from that of the one-shot game. In this regard, using the well-known folk theorem888民间定理提供了一种构建“触发”策略的方法。具体来说，如果其中一名玩家偏离了策略，比如玩家 1，那么其他玩家也会将策略更改为Folk theorem gives a way to construct “trigger” strategies. Specifically, if one of the players deviates, say player 1, then other players will also change their strategy to the极小极大minimax一、保证玩家1至少会受苦one, to guarantee player 1 will suffer at leastmin𝝅(−1)⁡max𝝅(1)⁡ℒ1​(𝝅(1),𝝅(−1))\min_{\bm{\pi}^{(-1)}}\max_{\bm{\pi}^{(1)}}\mathcal{L}_{1}(\bm{\pi}^{(1)},\bm{\pi}^{(-1)})后面每个时间步的损失。因此，如果所有玩家都能获得低于其最小最大损失的损失，则任何玩家都无法从偏差中受益。loss in every later timestep. 对手塑造和建模。Opponent Shaping and Modeling.

我们的工作还从最近的实证文献中获得了重要启发Our work also takes significant inspiration from the recent empirical literature of对手塑造opponent shaping多智能体（强化）学习in multi-agent (reinforcement) learning(Foerster et al., 2017; Kim et al., 2021; Willi et al., 2022; Lu et al., 2022)，它开发了算法来塑造对手的未来战略，知道他们会, which developed algorithms to shape the opponents’ future strategies, knowing that they will适应adapt学习代理/玩家的动作。 然而， 大多数算法不享有理论保证，to the actions of the learning agent/player. However, most of the algorithms do not enjoy theoretical guarantees,例如，e.g.,取决于收敛性和/或它们收敛的策略的质量。on the convergence, and/or on the quality of the strategies they converge to.Letcher et al. (2019)证明了他们的称为“稳定对手塑造”的算法将会收敛。然而，这种保证仅适用于假设对手是幼稚学习者的情况proved that their algorithm called Stable Opponent Shaping will converge. However, the guarantee only applies when assuming the opponents are naive learners999在每个时间步，学习器根据最后一个时间步的损失采取一步梯度下降。At each timestep, the learner takes one step of gradient descent according to the loss at the last timestep.，并且无法保证对抗一般未知对手的表现。相比之下，我们的方法通过镜头, and there is no guarantee on the performance against general unknown opponents. By contrast, our method, through the lens of遗憾最小化regret-minimization，对于 任何可能的玩家/对手满足一些可证明的必要条件（参见§, is more general and robust against any possible players/opponents satisfying some provably necessary conditions (see §3.2).

在线学习的另一条相关工作是Another line of related work in online learning is动态dynamic遗憾最小化regret minimization(Zinkevich, 2003)。在此设置中，累积损耗与可随时间变化的比较器进行比较，但通常具有亚线性变化预算。因此，当环境较好时，动态后悔更合适。. In this setup, the accumulated loss is compared with a comparator that can change over time, but usually with a sublinear variation budget. Therefore, dynamic regret is more suitable when the environment is非平稳的non-stationary。为了鼓励玩家的策略适应对手策略的变化，我们还考虑动态比较器，但在博弈论设置中，并具有不同的遗憾概念。. To encourage the player’s strategy to adapt to the changes in the opponents’ strategies, we also consider dynamic comparators, but in game-theoretic settings, and with different regret notions.

假设条件Suppose Condition3让所有玩家都满意。定义中定义的诱导马尔可夫博弈的预期时间平均损失is satisfied for all players. The expected time-average loss of the induced Markov game defined in Definition4.2总是存在并且不依赖于初始分布。always exists and does not depend on the initial distribution.

证明。Proof.

修复任意玩家Fix any playeri∈𝒩i\in\mathcal{N}。不失一般性，我们可能会限制对政策的关注. Without loss of generality, we may restrict attention to policiesπ(i)\pi^{(i)}一切历史都给予全力支持。确实，通过that have full support conditioned on every history. Indeed, byCondition 3，如果, ifπ(i)​(ai|𝒉)=0\pi^{(i)}\left(a_{i}{\,|\,}\bm{h}\right)=0对于某些人来说for someai∈𝒜ia_{i}\in\mathcal{A}_{i}和and𝒉∈ℋ\bm{h}\in\mathcal{H}，那么必然, then necessarilyπ(i)​(ai|𝒉′)=0\pi^{(i)}\left(a_{i}{\,|\,}\bm{h}^{\prime}\right)=0为所有人for all𝒉′∈ℋ\bm{h}^{\prime}\in\mathcal{H}。在这种情况下，行动. In this case, actionaia_{i}从未被采取（从任何历史记录中），所以我们可以删除is never taken (from any history), so we can removeaia_{i}来自from𝒜i\mathcal{A}_{i}不改变限制时间平均损失，因为任何涉及的状态without changing the limiting time-average loss, because any state that involvesaia_{i}是暂时的，并且在极限内平均被访问的概率为零。is transient and has zero probability of being visited on average in the limit.

此外，如果每个参与者都使用以任何历史为条件的完全支持的策略，那么只要可用，每个联合动作都会以正概率被选择。因此，诱导马尔可夫链是不可约的。因此，时间平均损失存在并且与初始分布无关Moreover, if every player uses a policy with full support conditional on any history, then every joint action is selected with positive probability whenever it is available. Consequently, the induced Markov chain is irreducible. Therefore, the time-average loss exists and is independent of the initial distribution(Norris, 1998)。 ∎. ∎
